mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) may increase everolimus nephrotoxicity and immunosuppressive effects; everolimus may impair renal function, reducing torsemide efficacy.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and everolimus trough levels regularly; maintain adequate potassium and magnesium supplementation; adjust torsemide dosing based on renal function changes.
